question: Suggi is a famous folk dance form of _______ state of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

Suggi:

__
 
• Suggi dance is also a harvesting festival in Karnataka.
 
• It is mainly performed by Halakki Tribe.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

Other folk dances of Karnataka: 

__
